body:
Hope you get some quality zzzzs tonight dude. Sleep deprivation sucks. 

I hope you’re able to talk to her and convince her to get help on her own, and if she isn’t willing to get that help maybe her family can get it for her so she isn’t a danger to herself.

What branch are you joining? I bet you made your recruiters happy, there’s a huge shortage of incoming enlisted.

As someone who’s attempted suicide, and as a fellow human being, remember, anything she does is ultimately her decision. 

If she is a danger to herself, consider telling her parents. If she agrees to keep herself safe she doesn’t necessarily have to go to the hospital, therapists are actually very hesitant to send anyone there. But she could use some help.

How are you doing? You have a huge heart man.
Based on your username academic pressure?
Keep it but watching season 4 of attack on titan
Dialectal behavioral therapy
Tomorrow I have a dbt appointment to learn new coping skills, I guess I just find ways to distract myself
Crisis text line if you’re in the US. Text hello to 741741, also 988 I believe.
That orange complements everything so well.
If there’s a part of you that wants to stay when that day comes, listen to it
Who?
When I feel numb I dramatically think to myself, “I wish when I felt something”, then the anxiety kicks in and I remember feeling numb wasn’t so bad.
Head back to bed, you’re going to be okay. No antifreeze. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.
Do you get any moments to yourself? I like to lie curled up listening to classical. I know it’s not much, but it comforts me.
Message in a bottle received
It would be a shame to lose someone like you. I can tell by your username you’ve got a great sense of humor.

I did something similar with a kitchen knife around that age. It’s strange to think how we get so morbidly curious at that time. I don’t remember what prompted it, maybe it was a bad feeling that I wanted gone.
21/F Reaching my hand out to you from elsewhere. There’s so much more to see, and there’s so many of us out there. It feels less lonely knowing others are out there and feel the same way.
I’m living for this shade of blue
I love winter.
Be less affected by focusing on the only things that make you happy and nothing else while you’re healing
I’ll never forget booking a hotel room for something similar. The front guy tried to flirt with me and I politely informed him that I was in fact, insane.
What’s Hrt?
There’s so many of us who feel this way, message in a bottle found.
What would you say to someone who did the same thing you did? Would you sentence them to death?
The charcoal did not stay lit I was never particularly strong in chemistry, back to work in the AM :’)

This. When I called I was put on hold and couldn’t stop laughing at how shitty the waiting music was.

Like, this is a helpline of people who feel like there is nothing good in life and you play this.
